item.title: Man runs from stolen vehicle after seeing officers in Centreville, gun recovered: police
item.description: Fairfax County Police say a 20-year-old Woodbridge man was arrested after detectives located a stolen vehicle in Centreville and recovered a firearm during a foot chase.

item.title: 18-year-old killed, two teens injured after car crashes into pond in Wicomico County
item.description: Maryland State Police say an 18-year-old Rockville man died after a single-vehicle crash sent a car into a pond in Wicomico County. Two passengers were injured.

item.description: Families in Montgomery County have continued to express concern after a student was shot at Wootton High School on Monday. item.description: A collapsed sewer line is still triggering multiple sewage overflows into the Potomac River, raising E. coli levels in the process. After another setback to the clean-up, D.C. item.title: Man charged in alleged assault of 10-year-old at Silver Spring Dave & Buster’s
item.description: A 30-year-old Germantown man has been charged in connection with the alleged assault of a 10-year-old at a Silver Spring arcade. Police say there may be additional victims.

item.title: Lawmakers hold hearing to explore impact of DOGE cuts on DMV economy
item.description: Fairfax County is at the center of a congressional field hearing on the impact of federal workforce reductions. This is when members of the House Oversight Committee leave Capitol Hill to hear testimony on location.
